tasks: all 18; unchanged frozen legal candidate pools
initialization: same prepared fresh R77 seed2 common weights; no trained selector initialization
backbone: original R77 instance/method dual streams, pooling, decoder and shared score MLP retained
residual_input: the existing 3*128 instance/context/method features before the shared score MLP
residual_output_initialization: all zeros, so both initial utilities equal the fresh original model
residual_first_layer_initialization: same canonical global-method blocks in both arms; shared arm flattens those blocks

A_shared_residual.residual: one shared bias-free MLP, hidden width M_GLOBAL*32, applied to every legal method feature
A_shared_residual.output: original shared score plus the shared instance-dependent residual

B_private_residual.residual: one bias-free width32 MLP per global method ID, reused across that method's legal tasks
B_private_residual.output: original shared score plus that method's instance-dependent residual

parameter_control: new residual parameter counts exactly match; unused global IDs remain dormant and are reported, never added as candidates
objective: unchanged R77: 0.35 native CE + 0.35 within-instance comparison + 0.02 relative-gap risk + original ramped R-Drop
optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-4 weight_decay=1e-4; cosine successful-update schedule to 1e-6
execution: one existing allocation-owned 4090 per arm; logical batch1024, large micro cap352, eval batch256
batch_and_task_order: same deterministic natural R84/R77 full18 order; no winner-based sampling
checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct using TRAIN-fitted SBS; first exact tie retained
inference: sum the two scalar utility paths, then unchanged pair score differences and maximin; one full legal pool, no added bias, threshold, quota or ensemble
formal_evaluation: unique VAL checkpoint lock per arm, then complete same-version TEST and both LIBs
empirical_screen: B improves VAL macro Top1 while mean_cost and actual regret do not increase against both matched A and historical same-data R84A
mechanism_metrics: full TRAIN/VAL winner discrimination, fixed R84 target rescues/lost/new false picks, precision, recall and paired cost changes
acceptance_is_not_goal_completion: tiny gains or fewer zero-count groups alone do not resolve useful method recovery
historical_reference: R84A, same frozen NEW90k data; not a newly retrained no-residual control
evidence_boundary: R85 C has completed and not passed its joint VAL gate; remaining R85 arms were still running when this independent parameterization comparison was locked
literature_boundary: shared/private parameterization is EGT-independent and inspired by multi-task shared/private representations; no algorithm-selection performance guarantee or full Cross-stitch reproduction
